lede: Wisconsin carries the stronger underlying team rating — +5.8 against +1.2, a 4.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Wisconsin -8.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Wisconsin winning 72% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where Wisconsin leads Michigan State by 126 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 89% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
